tasks.title: Emptiness and coverage become audit failures
tasks.objective: A repo with discovery material but no roadmap/epics, or a confirmed spec no story references, fails project audit and sanitise --check with a named gap citing the authoring commands - instead of reporting Project audit OK on emptiness. Migration and adoption name the gap instead of staying silent.
acceptance_criteria: specs.py gains unreferenced_confirmed_specs(base) -> list[str]: confirmed spec_records paths minus the item['spec'] posix paths read from plans/roadmap.json via load_json (no roadmap.py import); record_signoff.workflow_input_problems uses it with byte-identical problem strings.

project.py gains alignment_gaps(base) composed into project_gaps(): no-roadmap fires when discovery material (harvested ledger entries, docs/decisions/[0-9]*.md, or confirmed specs) exists and plans/roadmap.json is absent/empty/without epics, with the authoring commands in the detail; spec-coverage fires one gap per unreferenced confirmed spec only when the roadmap has items.

doctor.py legacy_roadmap_gaps reports ('roadmap', ...) when the file is absent and discovery material exists, instead of early-returning []; absent without discovery stays clean; advisory tier only (no failure-count change).

The migrate skill gains a capability-gap step (state missing specs/epics/roadmap, name forge spec save/confirm + roadmap derive / epic add + add, never fabricate; project audit now names these gaps) and adopt's closing hint names specs and roadmap.
A fresh forge init scaffold stays audit-clean; the harness repo itself stays audit-clean; existing sign-off tests pass unchanged.
verify_commands: uv run --with pytest python -m pytest factory/tests/test_gates.py -q -k "project_audit or signoff or doctor_reports or sanitise"
tasks.reviewer_focus: Sign-off problem strings stay byte-identical after the helper swap; the discovery-material predicate cannot fire on a fresh scaffold; spec-coverage is gated on a non-empty roadmap so the empty case reports exactly one no-roadmap gap; doctor stays advisory (no exit-code change); no auto-generation of any roadmap/spec content anywhere.
